<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Kholo Bonekeeper](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3070)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Some kholos serve as conduits to the divine and are responsible for placating spirits and gods alike. [Lamashtu](/Deities.aspx?ID=287) is a favored deity of kholo bonekeepers, as many kholos believe their kind were birthed from the Mother of Monsters. While some kholos embrace the Old Mother completely, others see her as a nightmarish power only to be approached if they're willing to pay the price. Other popular kholo deities include [Calistria](/Deities.aspx?ID=279), [Nethys](/Deities.aspx?ID=288), [Mahathallah](/Deities.aspx?ID=170), or [Shelyn](/Deities.aspx?ID=293).

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 18

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 16

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13
</column>

</column>

</column>

</row>

<column gap="tiny">

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
falchion +10 ([Forceful](/Traits.aspx?ID=180), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194)),
**Damage** 1d10+3 slashing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +10 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 1d6+3 piercing

**Divine Prepared Spells** DC 20, attack +12
- **Cantrips (2nd)**
[Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246), [Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286)
- **1st**
[Command](/Spells.aspx?ID=45), [Fear](/Spells.aspx?ID=110), [Runic Weapon](/Spells.aspx?ID=1658)

[Darkness](/Spells.aspx?ID=59), [Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146) (×4), [Spiritual Armament](/Spells.aspx?ID=1687)

**Pack Attack**   A kholo bonekeeper deals 1d4 extra damage to any creature that's within reach of at least two of the kholo bonekeeper's allies.

**Rugged Travel**   A kholo ignores the first square of [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) they move into each time they Step or Stride.

</column>
